note: Validation gates. A strategy must pass every gate to qualify. Demotion gate sends a live strategy back to paper.

gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.rule: Definition frozen in git before the evaluation window opens; commit hash is the registration.

gates.name: Out-of-sample floor
gates.rule: n >= 300 graded games (owner to confirm, S-02).

gates.name: Proper-score skill
gates.rule: Benchmark-relative Brier skill with game-cluster lower bound > 0.

gates.name: Multiplicity
gates.rule: Adjustment for number of trials (Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.05).

gates.name: Control baseline
gates.rule: Must beat random-picks and favorites-only controls.

gates.name: Joint-evidence (parlays/props)
gates.rule: Directly validated joint probability + void/push rules required.

gates.name: Price evidence
gates.rule: Authorized market price required for residual/CLV/ROI claims.

gates.name: Demotion gate
gates.rule: Live strategy returns to paper if rolling Brier-skill lower bound < 0.
gates.status: defined — no live strategy to demote
